name: fan-out-estate
description: One network stack feeding two clusters feeding twelve apps, as fifteen independently-deployed CloudFormation stacks, deployed by a fan-out whose order is derived from the source.

scripts.build: npm run build:network && npm run build:clusters && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:clusters: chant build src/cluster-a --lexicon aws -o dist/cluster-a.template.json && chant build src/cluster-b --lexicon aws -o dist/cluster-b.template.json
scripts.build:apps: chant build src/app-01 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-01.template.json && chant build src/app-02 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-02.template.json && chant build src/app-03 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-03.template.json && chant build src/app-04 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-04.template.json && chant build src/app-05 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-05.template.json && chant build src/app-06 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-06.template.json && chant build src/app-07 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-07.template.json && chant build src/app-08 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-08.template.json && chant build src/app-09 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-09.template.json && chant build src/app-10 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-10.template.json && chant build src/app-11 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-11.template.json && chant build src/app-12 --lexicon aws -o dist/app-12.template.json
scripts.deploy:gated: chant components fan-out --base HEAD~1 --env local --gate release --resume .chant/fan-out.json --no-release-record
scripts.teardown: for s in app-01 app-02 app-03 app-04 app-05 app-06 app-07 app-08 app-09 app-10 app-11 app-12 cluster-a cluster-b network; do aws cloudformation delete-stack --stack-name $s; done
